newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-Dalgety sees growth this year.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Dalgety sees growth this year.

text.p: Dalgety Plc said the mad cow disease crisis has meant a difficult start to its current financial year, but the food and agribusiness group is confident of growth for the year as a whole.
Chief executive Richard Clothier said Dalgety had had a tough start to the year because of a drop in demand for cattle feed as well as problems resuming petfood exports.
Clothier said it was difficult to say how these factors would affect the year, but he expected the impact would mainly be in the first half.

"We've still not resumed (petfood) exports entirely and we have this reduction in cattle feed volumes, but despite those two we still expect the year as a whole to show significant growth," he said in an interview by telephone.

Uncertainty among farmers about how many cattle would be destroyed to wipe out bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE) or mad cow disease in Britain had reduced demand for cattle feed by about 20 percent in the past couple of months, he said.
"Everybody is waiting to see what the government's decision is on the cull."
